name: Free Territory, Ukraine
description: November 1918. The Austro-German occupiers are leaving southern Ukraine, and around Huliaipole the peasants have taken the land and formed free soviets. The Revolutionary Insurgent Army is a militia of volunteers. Whites to the south and east, Bolsheviks to the north — sometimes allies, never friends. Hold the Free Territory together until the summer of 1921.

events.title: The Second Regional Congress
events.text: Delegates from hundreds of villages meet at Huliaipole. The Whites are coming; how should the free soviets raise an army?

options.label: Voluntary, egalitarian mobilization
options.description: Each village sends whom it chooses. Fewer fighters, but they elect their own commanders.

options.label: General conscription
options.description: Every able man serves. A bigger army — and a staff to command it.

events.title: Trotsky's Order No. 1824
events.text: Trotsky bans the Fourth Regional Congress and declares the Makhnovists outlaws. Red troops are already on the move.

options.label: Hold the congress anyway
options.description: The soviets meet as free soviets. The Bolsheviks take it as a declaration of war.

options.label: Cancel it to keep the alliance
options.description: A few more weeks of Red support, bought with the villages' right to meet.

events.title: Peregonovka
events.text: Pursued hundreds of kilometres west by Denikin's army, the Insurgent Army turns to face it near Uman.

options.label: Turn and fight
options.description: A pitched battle with everything the army has. Victory would cut Denikin's supply lines.

options.label: Scatter into partisan bands
options.description: No battle, no command — the villages fight their own way home.

events.title: Typhus
events.text: A typhus epidemic sweeps the region over the winter. Makhno himself falls ill; whole units are bedridden.

options.label: Turn workshops over to hospitals
options.description: The movement's organizers and every spare cart go to the sick.

options.label: Carry on
options.description: Each village copes as it can.

events.title: The Starobilsk agreement
events.text: Wrangel is breaking out of Crimea. The Bolsheviks offer an alliance: amnesty for anarchists and freedom to organize, in exchange for fighting Wrangel.

options.label: Sign it
options.description: The Insurgent Army marches on Crimea alongside the Red Army.

options.label: Refuse
options.description: No more agreements with those who broke the last one.

events.title: Betrayal
events.text: Wrangel is beaten. The same week, Red troops arrest the Makhnovist delegates in Kharkiv and attack Huliaipole.

options.label: Fight on from the villages
options.description: Guerrilla war across the steppe, for as long as the villages will hide the army.

options.label: Form a single field command
options.description: Concentrate everything under one staff to break out of the encirclement.

communes.name: Huliaipole
communes.description: Makhno's home town and the movement's centre: anarchist since the 1905 revolution.

communes.name: Rosa Luxemburg commune
communes.description: An agrarian commune on a former landowner's estate.

communes.name: Dibrivka
communes.description: Where Makhno's partisans won their first battle against the occupiers.

communes.name: Molochansk colonies
communes.description: Prosperous, pacifist Mennonite settlements, wary of the insurgents.

communes.name: Oleksandrivsk
communes.description: Dnieper rail junction and factory town; its workers lean Bolshevik.

communes.name: Katerynoslav
communes.description: The regional capital, held only briefly. Its press and its factories could change everything.

communes.name: Berdiansk
communes.description: Azov port, taken by the insurgents in 1919.

communes.name: Yuzivka
communes.description: Donbas mining and steel town, fought over by everyone.
